title: Child Welfare Specialization Child Welfare Practicum
description: Develop, refine and apply generalist practice knowledge, skills, values and ethics while working under supervision in a child and/or youth and/or family serving agency with those who are affected by child welfare law, policy and practice. The practicum is 350 hours.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of SOCW 404A, SOCW 402, SOCW 404.
Students must submit an application for this course 6 months in advance of the start of the term.
Social Work accreditation standards require that students spend the hours noted above in practice.
Field Education courses have two components: a placement in the field and an integrative practice seminar (online).
